Synopsis:
What awaited Lady Okitsune, the chief exorcist priestess, when she went to rescue her daughter who had been kidnapped by demons?

This is a story about a demon-slaying shrine maiden mother who goes to rescue her daughter who has been taken hostage by demons, but is caught off guard by her daughter, who has already been transformed into a demon, and ends up growing a hermaphrodite body. She is then subjected to a double ordeal of semen extraction by her daughter and a female jellyfish demon.

■Synopsis of the previous work
Kanna, an exorcist shrine maiden who was fighting jellyfish-like demons that were attacking people in the city,
She is suddenly defeated by a powerful demon and taken hostage...
